class.name: FmodStaticPluginMethod
class.brief_description: A static FMOD plugin's registration method, for iOS.
class.description: iOS links FMOD plugins statically: each one exposes a C function returning its description, which the export registers with FMOD. List them in [member FmodPluginsSettings.static_plugins_methods].

members.member: The name of the plugin's C function returning its description, such as [code]FMOD_SteamAudio_Spatialize_GetDSPDescription[/code].
The kind of plugin the method describes.

constants.constant: A codec plugin, decoding an audio format.
A DSP plugin, processing audio as an effect.
An output plugin, sending FMOD's mix to an audio device.
